notes.title: UPDATE 1.103 is now Live!
notes.notes: -Due to the request by Valve, we replaced all semi-realistic images (17 images) from the base game with new non realistic anime images. Even though this was a request by Valve, the semi-realistic didn't really fit with the rest of the images in the base game.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 is now Live!
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURES
-New Image Pack Selection Dropdown
-New Sidebar in the Gallery to swap Image Pack when the user has DLC

IMPROVEMENTS
-Lock mouse scroll and drag when viewing an image in the gallery.
-Improved Gallery Slideshow interaction and buttons.

BUG FIX
-Fixed an issue where the song popup could still show up when toggled off.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.09
notes.notes:
BACKEND
- Added full support for eventual image packs. 
(Nothing will be visible or do anything yet, but it has been added.)
+More info soon!

FIXES
- Fixed a bug where the player could restart a new "word of the day" immediately after failing it.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.072
notes.notes:
BUG FIX 

 For certain users the New Gallery Background feature was not properly saving each background that were set.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 is now Live! - Gallery Image as Background and more!
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURES


 Added button after winning and unlocking a new image to view it in the Gallery immediately

 Added Optional Default Game Backgrounds (instead of black)
(Accessible in the Pause Menu by pressing ESC or Right-Clicking while playing a game)

 Added the ability to set any unlocked image from the gallery to LEFT and RIGHT background manually. 
This way we have an infinite amount of background possibilities. 
(You can set an unlocked image immediately after a game, or from the gallery page.)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 is now Live!
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURES
- Added Color Assist mode
- Added a new optional Helper Sidebar to show used letters
- Added "Now Playing" popup when song changes

FIXES
- Fixed Options Menu Buttons to show which tab is selected
- Fixed Slideshow speed slider that was previously inverted
- Fixed a small issue in the "Word of the Day" mechanics
